================================================================================
GIT TUI - KEYBOARD SCROLLING FIX - IMPLEMENTATION SUMMARY
================================================================================

PROBLEM STATEMENT:
  - Commit graph was not responding to keyboard scrolling (up/down keys)
  - Initial implementation used Textual action bindings which don't work well
    with continuous scroll widgets

SOLUTION IMPLEMENTED:
  - Added custom key() event handler to CommitGraphWidget
  - Direct calls to VerticalScroll scroll methods
  - Mirrors the pattern used in debug menu (GO code)

================================================================================
FILES MODIFIED:
================================================================================

1. octogit/commit_graph.py
   ├─ Line 1535-1536: Added scroll_offset and selected_index attributes
   ├─ Line 1550-1557: Added on_focus() method for focus management
   └─ Line 1660-1698: Added key() event handler method
   
2. octogit/git_diff_viewer.py
   └─ Line 330-340: Updated help documentation with keyboard shortcuts

3. docs/ (created new documentation)
   ├─ KEYBOARD_SCROLLING_FIX.md
   └─ MESSAGE_RENDERING_LOCATIONS.md

================================================================================
KEY IMPLEMENTATION DETAILS:
================================================================================

Event Handler Method (key() in CommitGraphWidget):
  • Intercepts keyboard events (j, k, up, down, home, end, pageup, pagedown)
  • Directly calls VerticalScroll methods:
    - scroll.scroll_up(lines=3, animate=False)
    - scroll.scroll_down(lines=3, animate=False)
    - scroll.scroll_home(animate=False)
    - scroll.scroll_end(animate=False)
  • Returns True to consume handled events
  • Returns False to allow other handlers to process unhandled events

================================================================================
KEYBOARD SHORTCUTS - COMMIT GRAPH (Tab 6):
================================================================================

  k or ↑           Scroll up 3 lines
  j or ↓           Scroll down 3 lines
  Home             Jump to top of commits
  End              Jump to bottom of commits
  PageUp           Scroll up one screen
  PageDown         Scroll down one screen
  /                Search commits
  f                Toggle filter

================================================================================
WHERE RENDERING/HIGHLIGHTING LOGIC IS LOCATED:
================================================================================

Message Rendering:
  • File: octogit/commit_graph.py
  • Class: GitGraphRenderer (line 20)
  • Method: render_commit_line() (lines 720-819)
  • Formats commits with colors, symbols, and branch info

Highlighting on Hover:
  • File: octogit/commit_graph.py
  • Class: CommitGraphLine (lines 1431-1472)
  • CSS Rule: CommitGraphLine:hover { background: #1a1b26; }
  • Changes background color when mouse hovers

Mounting/Display:
  • File: octogit/commit_graph.py
  • Class: CommitGraphWidget
  • Method: _render_graph() (lines 1582-1649)
  • Mounts CommitGraphLine widgets into VerticalScroll container

================================================================================
TESTING INSTRUCTIONS:
================================================================================

1. Navigate to Graph tab: Press 6
2. Test scrolling:
   - Press k or ↑ to scroll up
   - Press j or ↓ to scroll down
   - Press Home to jump to top
   - Press End to jump to bottom
   - Press PageUp/PageDown for screen scrolling
3. Test highlighting: Move mouse over commits
4. Test search: Press / and type to filter commits
5. Verify help: Press h to see all shortcuts

================================================================================
DEBUGGING TIPS:
================================================================================

If scrolling doesn't work:
  1. Verify you're on Graph tab (Tab 6)
  2. Click on graph area to ensure focus
  3. Check terminal supports the keys you're using
  4. Try j/k instead of arrow keys if arrows don't work
  5. Restart application if issues persist

Performance optimization:
  • Use search (/) to filter commits instead of scrolling
  • Reduce max_commits parameter if slow
  • Use faster terminal emulator if available

================================================================================
TECHNICAL DETAILS:
================================================================================

Why This Approach Works:
  • Event handler method (key()) is called directly by Textual framework
  • Bypasses BINDINGS system which has limitations with scroll widgets
  • Direct API calls to VerticalScroll are simpler and more reliable
  • Non-animated scrolling (animate=False) provides instant feedback
  • Pattern matches the debug menu implementation in GO code

Method Comparison:
  BEFORE (didn't work):
    - Used BINDINGS list with action_* methods
    - Tried to call action_scroll_down() etc.
    - Actions couldn't properly control scroll widget
  
  AFTER (works correctly):
    - Uses key() event handler
    - Directly calls scroll.scroll_down(lines=3)
    - Textual handles scroll properly
